description: Turns a document into clean Markdown in about a second: pass an https URL or base64 of a PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, CSV or XML file and get the text back with its headings, tables and page markers, plus the token count. It reads the text layer, so a scanned page with no text layer comes back without text. You are only charged if the Markdown is delivered. No API key, no account. $0.01 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

document.description: The document, as base64. Use this or url.

filename.description: Name with extension, e.g. invoice.pdf. Helps the converter pick the parser. Default: taken from the URL.

url.description: https URL of the document to convert. Use this or document.

name: ai_document
title: Document to Markdown (PDF, Office, HTML)
